description: This file defines the class AggregatedDevOpsCommandResponse, which is a final immutable class extending AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse. It is used to represent a response that aggregates multiple CommandResponse objects, primarily used within a DevOps command context in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class provides methods for creating instances from JSON, managing response types, headers, entity payloads (disallowed), and custom JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: AggregatedDevOpsCommandResponse
